graph_policy.link_context: visible prose only; comments, frontmatter, code fences, and embeds excluded
graph_policy.structured_children: all resolved whereabouts and partOf references among in-scope canonical/primary-source notes
graph_policy.hierarchical_dependents: partOf references plus place-to-place whereabouts references; used for container-role proposals
graph_policy.located_entities: non-place whereabouts references; reported as structural context but not treated as subordinate places

content_policy.player_facing_visible: sum of unscoped visible prose and all campaign-scoped visible prose
content_policy.reservoir: campaign:none plus ordinary comment words; context only, never a deficiency signal by volume alone
content_policy.comparison: player-facing prose and graph measures are compared within assigned profile only
content_policy.container_candidate: at least three hierarchical dependents plus player-facing prose below the profile-aware container threshold; structural parenthood alone is not treated as importance
content_policy.publication_candidate: either excludePublish all plus substantial private material and near-zero public prose, or a private-heavy note with sparse public presentation; this prompts a decision rather than asserting that publication is required
content_policy.warning: Evidence and candidate signals are not editorial judgments.
